name: SIS-Fact Dataset
description: SIS-Fact is a high-quality document-grounded factuality evaluation dataset designed to measure the ability of models to detect and analyze diverse intrinsic and extrinsic factual errors in generated documents. It includes systematically synthesized error types and interpretable annotations for comprehensive factuality evaluation.
reputation: A relatively new, niche factuality benchmark from the recent literature; it is not yet as widely adopted as FEVER or FactCC, but is relevant for document-grounded error analysis.
notes: Includes ten diverse synthetic methods to generate six error types; supports fine-grained factuality evaluation and correction.
